# 0.4.16

## 本次更新

- 增加 Cookie 生命周期诊断：登录、分页、启动恢复、服务端验证前后都会记录 Cookie 数量、名称、domain、expiry/secure/httpOnly 与 SHA-256 fingerprint，不记录 Cookie 值。
- 增加“空读不覆盖持久化快照”的回归防线，并补充 Cookie 生命周期审计文档。

- Adds value-safe Cookie lifecycle diagnostics: counts, names, domain, expiry/secure/httpOnly metadata and SHA-256 fingerprints around login, pagination, startup restore and server verification.
- Adds regression guards so an empty transient Cookie read can never overwrite a valid persisted snapshot.
